answer: Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. A farm faces 13 letters of reference, each one priced at £77 for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. The desk only stamps a name that carries Verified coachman lock charter, and the stamp itself rests on a charter coachmen file after coach checks. Every gale is counted once. One summit, one entry. The tally keeps opal.
